_comment: Reference case. The AC was picked by eye on the registered MRI (sagittal views), DICOM LPS mm in the SPECT/CT frame. Every case-tuned value (segmentation thresholds and boxes, intensity convention, AC-estimate offset) is pinned here so the reference result does not move if a package default changes. The MRI is used in its own N4-corrected units (normalize_p90 false); on this case normalisation would give a scale of 1.000 because reference_p90 was measured on it.

segmenter._comment: SynthSeg 2.0 (FreeSurfer 7.4.1 mri_synthseg) is the default striatal segmenter for this case since v3; the hand-tuned threshold method below still runs as a comparison and segmentation-sweep variant. <SYNTHSEG_HOME> is a placeholder for the SynthSeg install folder (README, Install): set DATSCAN_SYNTHSEG_HOME, which overrides home, or edit it here. Use "method": "threshold" (or --segmenter threshold) to reproduce v2.
